Localize is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to join our growing product engineering team. As Localize expands, the scalability, reliability, and performance of our infrastructure and applications have become paramount. As a critical member of our product engineering team, you will own and improve Localize’s technical infrastructure, databases, and platform tooling, including monitoring, alerting, and maintenance. Your scope extends beyond delivering product tickets: you will strengthen the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and be responsible for the scalability, stability, reliability, performance, and security of the Localize platform.

You will partner closely with leadership and fellow product engineers to translate business priorities and customer needs into execution, remove obstacles, and make thoughtful tradeoffs that keep the team moving forward. Like every product engineer at Localize, you are expected to be customer-obsessed and business-aligned: connect technical decisions to customer trust, product quality, and business outcomes. This role reports directly to the Engineering Manager.

This is a hands-on software engineering role as well as an infrastructure ownership role. You will be expected to operate at a senior backend engineering level, contributing production application code and owning complex changes from design through rollout and ongoing operation. You will also contribute across the stack when needed to deliver complete customer-facing solutions, balancing product development with infrastructure, security, and developer experience priorities.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee and manage Localize's infrastructure across AWS and Cloudflare.
  • Design, build, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, and background processing workflows. Work hands-on in the Localize application, including the dashboard, public APIs, legacy workers, and BullMQ workers; not only the infrastructure that supports them.
  • Own complex product engineering work end to end: clarify requirements, propose pragmatic designs, implement application and infrastructure changes, and validate releases in production. Contribute frontend changes when needed to complete the customer experience.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment to data modeling, API contracts, asynchronous processing, and failure handling. Diagnose and resolve application-level performance and reliability issues, including inefficient queries, queue bottlenecks, and search behavior.
  • Raise the quality and maintainability of the codebase through automated tests, thoughtful code reviews, and incremental refactoring. Share knowledge and mentor teammates on backend design, debugging, and operationally sound software development.
  • Ensure the scalability, reliability, performance, and security of Localize's data stores, specifically Redis and MongoDB, through effective configuration, monitoring, query optimization, and backup management.
  • Own and improve deployment process and release processes, emphasizing automation, repeatability, safe rollouts, and reliable rollback procedures.
  • Partner with product engineers to improve the full SDLC, including development environments, CI/CD, automated quality and security checks, and release readiness. Treat this work as a core engineering responsibility alongside product delivery.
  • Take a leading role in infrastructure security and SOC 2 Type II compliance, partnering with engineering leadership and compliance stakeholders to operate and improve technical controls, maintain audit-ready evidence, support audits, and remediate findings. Responsibilities include access management, vulnerability management, change management, logging, and backup and recovery controls.
  • Help lead incident response and blameless post-incident reviews, translating lessons into improvements that protect customers and reduce recurring operational risk.
  • Prioritize infrastructure and SDLC improvements based on customer impact, business priorities, and risk. Communicate tradeoffs clearly and assess results through reliability, delivery speed, security, and cost-efficiency.
  • Own and improve monitoring of uptime and performance using tools such as Datadog, Clickhouse, HyperDX, and more
  • Identify, plan and implement improvements and optimizations for infrastructure regarding cost, reliability, scalability.
  • Develop and maintain detailed documentation and maps of our infrastructure and dependencies.
  • Play an active role in Developer Experience enhancement
  • Actively learn new technologies and systems to improve the efficiency and capabilities of our infrastructure.

About Localize:

The Localize platform is used by 700+ companies to automate the translation of their web and mobile applications and bring their products & services to new markets at record speed. We support organizations like The Bay Area Toll Authority in translating their payments website, Baptist Health in making their healthcare site multilingual, and the Massachusetts Department of Elementary and Secondary Education in offering their content in several languages. To see our product in action, click any of those links and use the website's language switcher to switch from English to another language.

Localize works by providing a code snippet (similar to the Google Analytics JavaScript snippet) that our customers add to their website/web app. The Localize snippet pulls in content from the page into the Localize dashboard where our customers log in to add translations and manage their content. Localize automatically deploys those translations to the customer's production site, reducing development costs and accelerating time to market.

We are a team of ~30 people working fully remote. We offer competitive pay, a full benefits package, and a culture with an emphasis on work + life balance.

To apply:

Along with your resume, send us a cover letter that showcases your personality and tells us why we should hire you. Previous experience working in a remote position is a must.
